{"_type":"Error","errorIdentifier":"urn:openproject-org:api:v3:errors:Unauthenticated","message":"You did not provide the correct credentials."}

observation.command: echo "=== API check with default admin/admin ==="; curl -s -o /dev/null -w 'GET /api/v3/me (admin:admin): HTTP %{http_code}\n' -u admin:admin http://localhost:8080/api/v3/me; curl -s -u admin:admin http://localhost:8080/api/v3/me | head -c 400; echo; echo "=== API without auth ==="; curl -s -o /dev/null -w 'GET /api/v3/me (no auth): HTTP %{http_code}\n' http://localhost:8080/api/v3/me; echo "=== version ==="; curl -s -u admin:admin http://localhost:8080/api/v3/version; echo
